semiconductor_relevance: High — Samick THK specializes in robotics and motion technologies that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Samick THK is a leader in robotics and motion technologies, providing precise linear motion systems essential for automated semiconductor equipment. Their offerings include customized wafer transfer robots and smart factory solutions that enhance efficiency in semiconductor production.

regional_presence.Korea: Samick THK holds Korea’s largest market share in linear motion guides and ball screws, supported by significant production capacity.
